boundaries: Live queries use the current top card; dual types match once per Pokemon and distinct-type count uses a union. Older definitions without printed type metadata use the authoritative combat profile.
A preselected target cannot be substituted during potential-effect analysis; wrong typed targets are rejected before consuming a card.

Healing and status recovery share the selected target. A healed Bench target does not clear Special Conditions from an unrelated Active Pokemon. Applying Special Conditions to Bench Pokemon remains rejected.
Full healing discards Energy only from actual recipients. Pokemon with 30 HP remaining qualify for Bianca; 40 HP do not.
Prize effects count remaining rather than taken Prizes. Revenge requires opponent attack damage on the preceding turn, excluding damage counters.
Unsupported extra clauses, unrelated abilities and structural uncertainties remain unsupported.
